ACCESS: The user's right to access their data.
DELETION: The user's right to request deletion of their data.
MODIFICATION: The user's right to request modification of their data.
RESTRICTION: The user's right to restrict processing of their data.
PORTABILITY: The user's right to data portability.
OBJECTION: The user's right to object to processing of their data.
CONSENT_WITHDRAWAL: The user's right to withdraw consent for data processing.
AUTOMATED_DECISIONS: The user's rights related to automated decision-making.
INFORMATION: The user's right to receive information about data processing activities.
DATA_BREACH_NOTIFICATION: Notification requirements in case of a data breach.
